input.summary: Add a TrueLink performance/conformance warranty with a real remedy and carve it out of the disclaimer
input.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink's only warranty today is Y2K readiness, and the disclaimer leaves us without any conformance warranty. We have added a professional-services warranty and a 90-day conformance warranty with re-performance, repair/replacement or refund as the remedy.

ops.text: TrueLink further warrants that (a) the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards; (b) for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, the Interface and each deliverable will conform in all material respects to its documentation; (c) it will comply with applicable law in performing hereunder; and (d) the Interface and any deliverable will be free of viruses, worms, Trojan horses and other malicious code. Client's remedy for breach of this warranty is, at TrueLink's option, re-performance, repair or replacement, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming services or deliverable. The express warranties in this Section are not limited or excluded by any disclaimer in this Agreement.

input.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink hosts our web site and handles borrower credit data, so standard cover is required: CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M and cyber/privacy USD 5M, with certificates on request.

ops.text: 31. INSURANCE. TrueLink shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by law. TrueLink shall provide certificates of insurance on request.
